name: Default
shortDescription: Open-source user onboarding platform for building in-app product tours, checklists, launchers and surveys, with PostgreSQL and Redis.

alerts.message: On first visit Usertour asks you to create the System Admin account; do it right after deploying. Inviting members, sign-up links and password resets need SMTP (EMAIL_HOST, EMAIL_PORT, EMAIL_USER, EMAIL_PASS, EMAIL_SENDER), and image uploads need S3-compatible storage (AWS_S3_*), both added as environment variables.
